newsitem.title: UK: Shorts wins 10 mln stg helicopter contract.
newsitem.headline: Shorts wins 10 mln stg helicopter contract.

text.p: Belfast-based aerospace company Short Brothers Plc said on Friday it had won a 10 million stg contract to supply airframe components for 67 Apache attack helicopters ordered by Britain.
Shorts, a subsidiary of Bombardier Inc, said it had signed a contract with GKN Westland Helicopters Ltd to manufacture engine nacelles, stub wings and horizontal stabilisers for the helicopters.
A joint venture company in which Shorts has a 50 percent stake will also manufacture, integrate and test missile systems for the aircraft, Shorts said.
"Once the missile contracts are finalised they are expected to be valued at approximately 25 million stg," Shorts said in a statement.
Shorts Vice President Ken Brundle said the agreements signed on the Apache would create or sustain up to 90 jobs in Belfast.
